component.name: freeglaz
component.summary: Drive an HP DesignJet Z9: printing and ICC color profiling

description.p: freeglaz is an open toolkit that drives an HP DesignJet Z9 for printing and ICC color profiling — native and custom (the latter via ArgyllCMS, which is bundled) — without the vendor's proprietary utilities.

ul.li: OS- and driver-independent pipeline: freeglaz drives the Z9 over its network interfaces.
Colorimetric non-interference: a 16-bit file is carried byte for byte to the printer's engine, no conversion.
Gloss Enhancer restricted to the image area.
Custom ICC profiling via ArgyllCMS, and the printer's built-in profiling.
A demo mode to explore the app without a printer.

description.p: freeglaz distributes no HP code. It is not affiliated with HP; HP and DesignJet are trademarks of their respective owners.

screenshot.caption: The Print screen — loaded paper, print parameters, live ink levels
Choosing a profiling path — built-in or ArgyllCMS

description.p: Fixes an image opened from a file manager, or handed over by another application, being uploaded but never shown: the window opened empty.
Sending an image to freeglaz while it is already open now reuses that window instead of opening a second one — a file manager's "Open With", or another application handing over an export.
Settings toggle to show or hide the experimental Convert tab.
Experimental Convert tab: DeviceLink conversion to the loaded paper via ArgyllCMS, gamut intents including relative colorimetric with black point compensation, and hand-off to the Print screen.
Raw SOAP tracing behind a flag; chart placement offset.
The app version is shown in Settings, under About.
Self-contained Linux Flatpak (bundled dependencies, libvips and ArgyllCMS) attached to each release; native Wayland.
Offline demo mode; macOS app packaging. First Flatpak packaging.
